en.headline: Five students injured by falling concrete at Kwai Chung school
en.dek: Police are treating the case as an accidental injury after the students were taken to hospital with light injuries including eye and head complaints.
body: Five students were injured when concrete fell during works at a school in Kwai Chung on Saturday morning, police said.

The incident happened at about 10:19 a.m. at Ju Ching Chu Secondary School on On Chit Street. The students suffered light injuries including headaches, ear pain and eye injuries, and were taken to Princess Margaret Hospital.

Police have classified the case as an accidental injury and are investigating. Reports said construction workers were present at the scene and that at least one vehicle was also affected by the falling concrete.

zh.headline: 葵涌裘錦秋中學工程石屎墮下 五名學生輕傷送院
zh.dek: 警方列作有人意外受傷處理，學生報頭痛、耳痛及眼部受傷，已送瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
body: 葵涌一間中學周六早上進行工程期間，有石屎墮下弄傷五名學生。
警方於上午約十時十九分接報，安捷街裘錦秋中學內進行工程時有石屎墮下，五名學生分別報頭痛、耳痛及眼部受傷，已由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
警方將案件列作有人意外受傷處理，正調查事件。有報道指現場有工程人員進出，亦有車輛被波及。
